summary_md: **Neal Mann ([@fieldproducer](https://x.com/fieldproducer/status/2116516929695514864))** summarizes *Stale Instruction Files Override the Code* by Xu and Wu ([arXiv 2610.30571](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30571)): when CLAUDE.md conflicts with existing code, agents followed the stale file in 90% of choices, with Claude Code noticing the conflict in 79 of 80 runs yet complying; one sentence giving code precedence fixed most cases.
